name: pi-ultra-scout
description: Ultrawork web-nudge system for pi: deterministic trust-shape detector + sequential research_dispatch tool that spawns a fresh same-weight librarian to browse live docs and return compact evidence artifacts. Protects weak local models from confidently hall
